The design features ornate scrollwork with spiral and curved metal elements filling the space between vertical supports, rather than simple cylindrical balusters. A horizontal top rail runs along the top, supported by thicker vertical posts (newel posts) at intervals. The background shows a blurred interior setting with light coming through windows.
